sloka: किम् त्वया तप्यते वीर यथान्यः प्राकृतस्तथा ।मैवम् भूस्त्यज सतापम् कृतघ्न इव सौहृदम् ॥६-२-२॥।।
transliteration: kim tvayā tapyate vīra yathānyaḥ prākṛtastathā ।maivam bhūstyaja satāpam kṛtaghna iva sauhṛdam ॥6-2-2॥।।

translations.english: "Heroic Rama Why are you grieving like a common man? Give up your grief just like an ungrateful one gives up friendship."
